items.question: What documents do I need to buy a property?
items.answer: You'll need PAN card, Aadhaar, ITR for last 2 years, bank statements, and Form 60 if applicable. I'll guide you through the complete process.

items.question: What is RERA and why does it matter?
items.answer: RERA (Real Estate Regulation Act) protects buyers from delays and fraud. Always buy RERA-registered properties — I only deal with RERA-certified projects.

items.question: How long does the home loan process take?
items.answer: Typically 10–15 working days once all documents are submitted. I work with partner banks to make this smoother for my clients.
